english: Oh.\nYou've come at just the right time. Come here a moment.
Do you need something from me?
Yes. Make me some tea.
Huh?
My favorite cup is the floral one\non the top shelf.\nDon't you dare get it wrong.
And for the sweets to go with the tea,\nI'll leave it to your taste.
Taste. Understand?\nThat's the important part.\nThink it through carefully.
Well then, I'll leave it to you. Fufu.
...Oh my, what's wrong?\nOnly five minutes left until tea time.\nWhy aren't you moving?
Um... why do I have to\nmake the tea?
I'm sorry.\nI don't understand what you're saying.
I mean, tea time is almost here, right?\nIf nobody makes the tea,\nI won't get to drink any, will I?
That's what I mean... why does that someone have to be me?
Four minutes left.
Huh?
Say.\nIs there something you make sure to do\nat the same time every day?
Well, sort of.
See? Of course there is.\nHabits are such an important thing.
I can't think of one, actually.
Oh, really?\nYou should pick one.\nIt gives your life structure.
In my case, I drink tea\nat the same time every day.\nIt's a time I hold very dear.
And now, that precious tea time\nis approaching, moment by moment.
And yet you're not hurrying at all.\nMy, you must be impressive.
You can make tea really fast, right?\nConfidence is a wonderful thing.\nI can't wait to see how fast.
Um...
Could it possibly be,\nthough I can't imagine\nsuch a thing...
That right now, you have\nno intention of making the tea?
If that made me miss\nmy usual tea time,\nsuch a ridiculous situation...
You know what would happen, don't you?
U-uh...
Three minutes left.
U-um! The floral cup, right!?
Yes. The one with the pink rim.\nIt's my favorite, so don't get it wrong.
Y-yes! I'll make it right away!
(Ugh. That smile scares me.\nIt feels like I have no idea what she'll do!)
My, what a diligent worker. Good boy.\nYou'd make a fine servant. Fufu.
Say, look.\nThe flowers are wilting.
Poor things.\nIf someone would water them,\nthat'd be nice...
Ah, water for the flowers.\nI'll do that right after I refill the tea...
Say.\nDon't you think it's a lovely day today?
The sun is so wonderful.\nBut the sunlight might be a bit strong...
Ah, the parasol. I'll fetch it right away.\nUm, where was it...
Say.\nDon't get mad, just hear me out.
That tea refill I asked for feels\njust a tiny bit late.\nI hate being kept waiting...
A-ah, sorry!\nHere you go!
Fufu. Thank you.
Mmm, delicious.\nYou're learning my favorite temperature?\nGood boy. So good, I love you.
Oh? You look like you want to say something.\nWhat is it?
...May I really say it?
Of course you may.\nThey say bottling things up\nisn't good for you, right?
...No, it's nothing.
What are you holding back for?\nThat's not good, you know.\nIt's rude to me, too.
Come on. Say whatever you want.
Then I'll say it...\nAm I your servant, Yase-san?
I'm sorry.\nI don't understand what you're saying.
I mean, that's a strange question, isn't it?\nWhether you're my servant or not\nisn't for me to decide.
That's for you to decide.\nI'm not forcing you to do anything.
If you want to look after me, do.\nIf you don't, you don't have to.
Oh, I see.\nThen I'll be going home...
But.\nBefore you go, hear me out on one thing.
You are my favorite.
Liking something is my right, yes?\nIt's my personal feeling, after all.\nYou'll allow me that much, won't you?
Uh, well...
I've always been like this:\nI take very good care of my favorites.
Cups, clothes.\nAccessories, and my youkai subordinates too.
And here's the important part...\nsometimes a favorite goes missing,\nor wanders off somewhere.
When that happens, I get so sad.\nNo. Not just sad.
How should I put it...\nI can't find the right words, but\nif I had to say...
It pisses me off. A lot.
(S-scary...)
And when I'm pissed off, I rampage.
(Scary!)
But that has nothing to do with you.\nDon't worry about a thing.
Now, do as you like.\nIf you want to go home, go ahead?
(After hearing that, there's no way I can go home...)
...Oh? You're not going?\nThen I have another request.
I'm getting a craving for sweets.\nMay I ask you?
(I have to do something...\nI'll be her servant forever at this rate.)
Weeeell?
Ah, yes! Sweets, right?\nI'll bring them right away!
Thank you. Fufu.
Perfect timing.\nCould you come over here?
Ah, it's not tea.\nToday I want you to do this with me.
The things spread out on this table?\nWhat is this?
Sugoroku. I brought it from the Mirror Capital,\nbut I ran out of people to play with.
I used to play with my youkai subordinates,\nbut one of them was very ill-mannered.
That one went off somewhere,\nso now there's an empty seat.
Went off somewhere...
Hm? What is it?
(Th-there it is. The scary laugh.\nBetter not press this further...)
Anyway, I was getting bored\nplaying with the same people.
I thought playing with a human might be fun.\nYou'll play, right? You wouldn't refuse, would you?
...I can't refuse anyway, can I?
My, what rude phrasing.\nIt's like I'm forcing you.\nYou don't have to play if you don't want to?
It's just that I'll get grumpy.\nFufufu.
It does look kind of fun, actually.
Oh, you're getting into it.\nGood. I like that about you.
That attitude is admirable.\nFufufu.
Alright. I'll play.\nBut let me set one condition.
...A condition?
Yes. If I win this match,\nstop treating me like a servant!
Fufufufu.\nYou say the funniest things, little boy.
I don't recall ever making you my servant,\nbut fine. I accept.\nI'll take you on.
If you win, you're free.\nYou'll never have to make tea again.
...Really?
Oni don't lie.\nUnlike humans.
Shall we begin, then?\nA sugoroku match with your freedom at stake...
Hup! Dice, roll-roll-roll~♪
One, two, three... done, I finished! ♪
Ahahaha!\nI did it, I reached the goal!\nGoal, goal! ♪
Oh? Where are you, I wonder?\nAh, that's right.
You got sent to the youkai farm,\nin the middle of a thousand years of labor.\nNo coming back from there~
U-uuuhhh...
Fufufufu.\nFrustrated? Hey, are you frustrated?\nHow does it feel? Come on~
Oh? You look dissatisfied.\nI'll hear your complaints if you have any?
Th-that's cheating!\nIt's my first time, I don't know the rules...
Stop whining, it's unsightly.\nWhat an uncool kid you are, little boy.
Fufufu. But you know,\nI've taken a liking to your frustrated face.
Say.\nHow about this?
You lost this time because\nyou didn't know this sugoroku, right?
Then next time, you pick the game.\nBring something of yours,\nand I'll play you at it.
R-really?
Of course.\nBring whatever you like.
I'll beat you senseless\nand enjoy watching you cry.
Pl-please, a rematch...\nI'll bring a different game...
But before that,\nthere's something you need to do, right?
A tea refill, please?
...Yes.
Yase-san! I've come for our match!
My. You really came.\nFufu. I'm a little excited.
So, what game did you bring?
This... is it!
Oh, playing cards?\nYou brought something easy to understand.
Well, that's fine. This way, when you lose,\nyou can't blame the game, right?
So, what'll we play?\nYou get to choose?
Old Maid, please!
Hmm. Another\neasy-to-understand pick.
But are you sure?\nIt's a game you can't win if you're bad at lying.
Do you have confidence?
Of course!
Fufufu. Good.\nIt wouldn't be fun otherwise.
I wonder what your confident face\nwill look like when you lose...\nMm, I can't wait.
I'm not actually that confident...
Oh, come on.\nWhat's with that attitude before we even start?
Beating someone like that would be boring.\nHave more pride.
Well then, shall we begin?\nWin or lose, no hard feelings. Okay?
...It's gotten close.\nI have one card left, you have two.
If I draw anything but the old maid here, I win.\nHmm, what should I do?
Say, which one's the old maid?\nThe right? Or the left?
I-I'm not telling you that!
I know~\nI just want to enjoy the mind games.
This one? Or this one?\nWhich is your old maid~?
Oh? You keep a straight face better than I thought.\nFufu. Now I'm in trouble.
But I have to decide.\nOkay! I'll draw the right one!
(Yes! The right one IS the old maid!\nThis gives me another chance!)
It's fine if I draw the right one, right?
Like I said, I'm not telling you...
It's fine if I draw the right one, right?
H-huh...?
Hm? Well?\nI'm going to draw it. Is that okay?
U-um... I might\nnot recommend it...
Oh, is that so.\nThen I'll draw the left one. Here I go!
Aha! ♪ They matched!\nThat makes me the winner~
Uuuuh... that's cheating!\nThat was basically a threat at the end!
Whatever do you mean?\nI was just asking normally.\nIt's within the bounds of mind games.
What's normal about that...\nUgh, I was so close...
Fufufufu. Frustrated?\nYou lost again, are you frustrated?\nCome on, tell me~
I really do love that face of yours.\nYou'll show it to me again, right?
I'll be waiting, looking forward to it.\nCome anytime. Fufufu.
Yase-san. This time, poker, please.
Back to lose again?\nYou really never learn, little boy.
Th-this time I'll win!\nYou can't threaten me in poker!
I never did any such thing.\nHow rude.
Say, before our match,\nmay I make a suggestion?
I've been thinking I might\ngive you a handicap.
A handicap...?
Yes. Losing every time you come,\nyou look so pitiful and unsightly,\nit's too sad to watch.
So I'll make the terms easier for you to win.\nThe game is poker, right?
Let's say you only need to win once.
You can play as many rounds as you like.\nIf just once your cards are stronger than mine,\nyou win.
Really!?
But there are two conditions.
First, it only counts if I call\nand accept the match with you.\nThat's obvious for poker, right?
And the second one is...
Ask me nicely. ♪
Huh?
'Please give me a handicap, Yase-san.'\nTry asking. Then I'll consider it.\nFufufu.
Guh... gnnnn...
Ahaha! You don't want to say it?\nIt hurts your pride to bow your head?
That's how it should be~\nI want to see that face of yours!
As a reward I'll give you the handicap!\nDo your very best~
Give me a handicap, Yase-san!
...My. You said it so easily.\nThat was a bit anticlimactic.
I wanted to see you more frustrated,\nwith a face like you might cry.
Well, fine. A promise is a promise.\nI'll give you the handicap properly.
Now then, the poker match.\nShall we begin?
(Come on, come on, come on, come on...)
(It's here! Four kings!\nWith this I absolutely win!)
Fufu.\nYour smile is showing, you know?
Well, you seem to have a good hand,\nbut I have a pretty good hand too.
What should I do?\nWould calling be dangerous?
(Please call!\nWith this hand I absolutely win!)
Let me think a moment.\nHmm...
...Okay. I've decided.\nI'll call!
Since you have such a good hand,\nit'd be a shame if I folded, right?
You'll regret that confidence.\nI have four kings!
My, amazing!\nYou really did have a good hand!
Ah, hold your celebration.\nWait until you see my hand?
Here. I have four aces.
Wh-what!?
Ufufufu! That makes it my 30th straight win!\nFrustrated? Come on, are you frustrated?
Oh? You look like you want to say something.\nWhat's wrong?
Um... during our matches,\nsometimes I sense a presence behind me...
That's not one of your youkai subordinates, is it?
Whatever do you mean?\nI have no idea what you're talking about.
(She's definitely peeking...\nThere's no way I can win like this...)
Shall we call it a day?\nThen maybe I'll have you do some weeding.
Today and tomorrow,\nyou're my servant again. Ufufu.
Say, excuse me?
Whoa! Y-Yase-san!?
What? Startled by my face?\nHow rude.
B-but you coming to visit me\nis unthinkable...
I was in the neighborhood shopping.\nMe visiting a human is normally\nunthinkable, of course.
But there's something I just\nhad to say to you alone.
...Why haven't you come to play lately?
H-huh...?
I was finally getting a nice way to kill time,\nand I was looking forward to your visits...
But no matter how long I wait,\nyou never show up!\nWhat is this!?
If there's a reason, say it.\nWere you sick or something?
Yes. I caught a bit of a cold.
Don't lie!
Why tell such an obvious lie!?\nDon't think you can fool me!
I-I'm sorry...
My health was fine, actually...
...Hmph. Good for not lying.\nI'll give you credit for that.
But I can't forgive you for stopping!\nIt's like you stole my fun!
Say it honestly.\nWhy did you stop coming?
Because... I never win, no matter what.
...I'm appalled. That's your reason?
If you can't win,\nthen put in the effort to win!
But you do nothing and just run away...\nUgh, so uncool. Humans, honestly.
That's a harsh way to put it...
But it's true, right?\nYou're scared, aren't you?
Thinking only about losing before you even play.\nCoward's spirit. So like you.
You can say that because\nyou never lose...
Obviously.\nThere's no way I'd lose.
If I lost, I'd do\nanything you say.
Any...thing?
Yes, of course.\nWhatever you order, I'll obey.
Is that true?
Don't be tedious! Oni don't lie!
...Understood.\nIn that case, let's play once more!
Oh, really?
Ahaha! I'm so happy~\nI get to see your frustrated face again!\nI'm getting excited~
You won't be so relaxed\nfor much longer!
Fufu. You're cute when you're spirited.\nThat's how it should be?
Come again soon.\nI'll be looking forward to it.
...You've come.
Coming back for another match without running—\nI'll praise you for that. Fufu.
But quite some time has passed\nsince our last match, hasn't it?
I plan to make up for all that missed\nlosing-face in one go today.
I'd like to see at least a half-crying face.\nMind if I reserve one?
Today I'll wipe that confidence right off you!
My! How spirited.\nGood, good. That's how it should be.
I want to see that confident face crumble.\nYou know exactly what I like~
Don't talk nonsense.
What? No fun at all.\nKeep that attitude and I won't hold back?
I really will make you cry.\nBe prepared.
So, what are we playing today?
Concentration today.\nNo threats or peeking possible with this.
I told you I never did any such thing.\nHow rude.
But Concentration?\nIsn't that the worst possible pick for you?
I mean, it's a memory game, right?\nAre you sure? With your bird-sized brain?
Say what you want.\nToday's me is different from before.
(Today, I put in the effort to win!)
You're fired up.\nI wonder what that face will look like\nin a few minutes?
Tearful with frustration,\ntrembling and shaking?
Oh, I can hardly wait.\nUfufufu...
Uuuuhhh...
This card just appeared for the first time, but\n...I bet it's here!?
Ahh! Correct again!?
Why, why!?\nThis is definitely wrong!
You've been getting them\non the first try this whole time!
It's coincidence. You're rude, Yase-san.
C-coincidence? Really a coincidence?\nUgh, there are barely any cards left...
A-at this rate I'll lose...\nUuuuh...
(She's weak when the cheating is done to her.\nShe hasn't noticed at all that these are\nthe marked cards I borrowed from Mion-san...)
Um, this card is probably...\n...here, I bet!?
Ahh! No!\nDon't take any more!
I'm telling you not to take it!\nNo, nooo!
Even if you say no, those are the rules.\nYes. Got it.
Ahh...\nIf you take that card, then...
Even if I take all the rest, it's hopeless...\nNo comeback possible...
...I... I lost.
Well, sorry for the total victory.\nHm? Didn't we have some kind of promise?
Ugh...
F-fine. I understand.\nI won't treat you like a servant anymore.
Huh? Was that the whole promise?
Guhhh...
Ugh! I know!\nI'll do whatever you say, okay!?
Yes, yes. That's it.\nThat's the important part.
...Wh-what are you planning to make me do?
You've treated me like a servant all this time.\nI'll think of something fitting by next time.\nLook forward to it!
Gggh.\nGetting cocky... you mere human...
Um... where exactly am I?\nAh, Yase-san.
...What are you spacing out for?\nCome on, let's go already.
Go where? What are we doing?
...Are you joking?
You're the one who ordered it!\nYou called it the loser's punishment game!
I can't believe you thought of that...\nYou're truly an unbelievable man...
...What are you staring blankly for?\nGet in the room already.
Don't tell me you mean to do it\nright here!?\nI won't allow that!
Um, I have no idea what's going on...\nbut anyway, I should go in this room?
...W-well then,\nI'll get ready, so wait.
(What did I order, again?\nMy memory is kind of fuzzy...)
...I'm ready.
Kh... I-I'm embarrassed.
I-I'm Yase-douji, ruler of all the youkai of the Mirror Capital!\nWhy do I have to do this...
...Wh-what is that outfit?
I really will get mad!\nYou're the one who said it!
You told me to work as your servant!
R-right, I guess.\nIt's starting to come back to me.
It pains me, but I'll keep my promise.\nI lost the match, so it can't be helped...
Here. I made you tea.\nDrink as much as you like, okay?
...What's with that look?\nAre you saying I should act more like a servant?
Kh...
Y-your tea is ready, Master.
(Th-this is great.\nAll my grudges are melting away!)
Kh... Why does someone like me\nhave to serve a human...
...So, what should I do next?
Um, then... maybe feed me some sweets...
Y-you mere human!\nDon't get too carried away!
Wh-what! It's your fault for losing!?\nI fought fair and square!
...Y-you're right.
I did lose...\nSo it can't be helped...
If that match really was\nfair and square... that is...
H-huh?\nHer voice is getting distant...
...Good morning.
You were sleeping so soundly.\nI've been wondering what to do\nwith that sleeping face.
(I was asleep... so all of that was a dream!?)
Sorry to bother you right after waking,\nbut could you look at something interesting?
See, these cards.\nEach back has a scratch on it.
Th-that's!?
With these, you can tell what's where\njust by looking at the backs.\nWhat a ridiculous thing, right?
Say.\nLet me hear your opinion.
What do you think should happen to\na ridiculous person who uses such a ridiculous thing?
Y-you were cheating too!\nI wasn't the only one!
Oh? So you were cheating.\nThat's interesting to hear.
N-no, um...
Bad children like that need...
A punishment!
Gyaaaaah!!
